subject: E-Commerce
title: The Rise of Free Shipping
description: A quick, practical guide to The Rise of Free Shipping.

hook.text: Amazon launched Prime in 2005: $79/year for free two-day shipping. It changed what shoppers expect forever.

buildup.text: Before Prime, shoppers compared shipping costs carefully. A $5 shipping fee killed conversions.

discovery.text: Free shipping isn't free—it's baked into product prices. But psychologically, '$0 shipping' feels magical.

twist.text: Prime locked in 200 million members by 2023. They spend $1,400/year versus $600 for non-members.

climax.text: Prime made free shipping the baseline. Every retailer now subsidizes shipping or loses customers.

punchline.text: $79/year, 200M members. Free shipping became the price of competing.

quiz.question: How much more do Prime members spend annually versus non-members?
